card.name: Start of pump, lump, clump words
card.fires_on: The first letter or letters (p, l, cl) of a word that is about to continue as -ump, such as pump, lumps or clumping. It fires just before the 'umps' ending.

card.writes: It pushes toward word continuations that are not lump or chunk, and it suppresses lump, chunk and dump.
card.plain: It marks the start of a word like pump, lump or clump, just before the rest of the word appears.
